overall_prep_notes: Total prep ~1.5 hours. The two character puppets (Coda, Looper) print on cardstock. Card decks (M2, M3, M5, M8) are laminated. Grid mat is the centerpiece.

assets.name: Coding Grid Mat
assets.purpose: Letter-size 5×5 grid mat for code execution.
assets.page_layout: Single letter page, landscape with 5×5 grid.

image_placeholders.description: A 5×5 grid mat in B&W on a landscape letter page. Each cell ~1.5in × 1.5in. Coordinates labeled (0-4 on x and y axes). A small starting position dot at (0,0).

teacher_prep_steps: Hand out at start of Lesson 1.
assets.quantity_per_class: 1 mat per pair = 10+ for class of 20.
